blocks.heading: Plan the day, not the entire universe
blocks.body:
Yesterday starts with a drawer containing everything you could do, then asks you to choose what actually belongs today. Tasks can be organized into Must Do, Communications and general lists, placed into scheduled work blocks, and rolled forward when unfinished. Reflection, due dates, theme controls and dense keyboard navigation are part of the same idea: make daily planning more honest without turning it into another management job.

The desktop app is built with Electron, React and TypeScript and runs on Windows and macOS.
